biotools.summary: Vulture is a cloud-based pipeline for scalable mining of microbial reads in public single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data. It enables meta-analysis of host-microbial interactions and offers improved speed and cost-effectiveness compared to existing tools.
